title: COMMUNITY-CROSS-INSTRUCT: Unsupervised Instruction Generation for Aligning Large Language Models to Online Communities
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework for aligning LLMs with the viewpoints of online communities. While it includes evaluation questions on topics with moral and political weight, such as abortion and gender identity, the primary goal is to measure the fidelity of community representation (alignment) rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, formal moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
